title: New legal client intake request
note: A practice-derived operational list. It is not legal advice. The responsible lawyer decides what the matter needs and what the firm's bar or law society requires.

situations.organization: Client is a company or other organization
situations.litigation: Matter is a dispute or litigation
situations.transaction: Matter is a transaction or contract
situations.deadline: A court date, limitation period or other deadline is known
situations.prior-counsel: Another lawyer worked on the matter before

items.label: Government-issued photo ID for each individual client
Full legal name, address, phone and preferred contact method
Formation documents and proof of the signer's authority
Names of owners, directors and officers
Names of every other party, and their lawyers if known
items.detail: Used for the firm's conflict check before work starts.

items.label: Names of related companies, family members or witnesses involved
Short written summary of what happened and the outcome wanted
Contracts, letters, notices or other documents about the matter
Any court papers, claims or demand letters received
Any hearing notices or known deadlines
Term sheet, drafts and the other side's contact details
Prior lawyer's name and a copy of the file
Signed engagement letter or fee agreement
Retainer payment, if the engagement letter requires one
